pendingArc.speaker: The guild
pendingArc.text: The actors' guild has called a strike. Every set in the business went dark this morning. Yours among them: "Bunker 85". The lawyers call it force majeure, which means pay-or-play pays nothing, and not every picture stopped by a strike starts again. "The Avenue of Stars" will not open when it was meant to: nobody can sell a picture its actors are not allowed to talk about. The studio has moved it back 4 months. The guild says 3 months. Nothing new will be cast until it is over, and the picket at the studio gates starts at seven tomorrow.

choices.label: Walk the picket line
choices.hint: Every morning at the gates. The people next to you will remember who was there.

choices.label: Stay home
choices.hint: It is not your fight. Or it is, and you cannot afford to stand in it.

choices.label: Shoot an advert abroad, quietly
choices.hint: A day for a brand in a country where nobody reads the trades, €269,376. If it gets out, the guild will know who crossed.
